description: This PHP script handles AJAX requests related to network diagnostics, including ping tests and route tracing for IPv4 and IPv6 addresses. It processes POST requests to perform connectivity checks, trace routes, and returns the results in JSON format.

methods.name: validLink
methods.description: Validates if the provided link address is valid.

methods.name: validIPAddr
methods.description: Validates if the provided IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) is valid.
